author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: s1_q is triggered on both dst_clk edges: CDC-043(b) WARNING Unresolved. A required dual-edge stage cannot establish containment, so the crossing is neither safe nor an established defect. CDC-003's trigger and severity for this unresolved chain are not stated by the spec, so it is not expected; Reader B's CDC-003 addition rejected.

author_reading.rationale: First synchronizer stage is clocked on both edges of dst_clk; dual-edge behaviour is not modelled, so containment is undecided.

labels.rationale: The required first stage samples on both edges. The single-edge synchronization model cannot establish containment or the effective resolution interval.

First synchronizer stage s1_q is triggered on both edges of dst_clk (always @(posedge dst_clk or negedge dst_clk) s1_q <= src_q at design.sv:15). Dual-edge stage timing is unmodeled, disclosing CDC-043 WARNING Unresolved (clock-relationships INCOMPLETE) and leaving CDC-003 synchronizer containment Unresolved.
